Upon dispatch, your parcel transitions into the care of the carrier and you. Delivery is then subject to the refined terms and conditions of the appointed postal service and local delivery partner.


Once dispatched, any inquiries regarding delivery must be directed to the relevant carrier using the tracking link we provide. We invite you to monitor your shipment's journey and liaise directly with them and customs.


Please note, SALLY SKOUFIS™ is not responsible for any loss, theft, or delay of parcels once they have departed our headquarters.


All deliveries are carbon neutral, reflecting our commitment to harmony. International consignments are tracked and may require signature upon receipt, ensuring your precious items arrive securely.


Shipping timeframes may vary, influenced by carrier conditions, customs processing, and public holidays. Delivery estimates apply to in-stock items only. For bespoke pieces, you will receive personalized email updates on production and delivery timelines throughout the process.


Please note that import duties and taxes may apply depending on destination and are the responsibility of the customer.

settings.question: Bespoke Order Policy

settings.question: A Considered Approach

settings.question: Warranty & Repair Information
settings.answer:
Each hand-crafted SALLY SKOUFIS™ piece is created with exceptional attention to detail and is accompanied by a six (6) month limited warranty, effective from the date of purchase and valid upon presentation of proof of purchase and successful assessment approval.

This warranty covers manufacturing faults and material defects only. Where a piece is confirmed as faulty following evaluation by our jewellers, we may, at our discretion, offer a repair or replacement.

Please note that general wear and tear resulting from normal use is not considered a manufacturing fault. The warranty does not extend to loss of jewellery, chain breakage, tarnishing or fading of plated finishes, or stone loss caused by impact, movement, or wear.

Repairs requested outside the six-month warranty period are subject to a $60 service fee, in addition to return shipping arranged by the client. Such repairs are classified as general wear servicing and are assessed accordingly.

settings.question: Materials
settings.answer: At SALLY SKOUFIS™, we create fine jewellery defined by hand sculptural craftsmanship, responsible sourcing, and considered design. Each piece is developed using precious materials and artisan techniques that honour both heritage practice and contemporary ethical awareness.

settings.question: Gemstones
settings.answer:
We use premium-grade cubic zirconia, the highest calibre of diamond simulant, selected for its exceptional brilliance and clarity. Each stone is sustainably produced by long-standing global partners, then precision-cut, polished, and hand-set by master artisans for their refractive brilliance.

  • Material: Man-made zirconium dioxide (ZrO₂)
  • Classification: Diamond simulant
  • Hardness: 8.5 on the Mohs scale
  • Clarity: Eye-clean
  • Cut: Precision multifaceted cuts for maximum brilliance
  • Setting: Hand-set micro pavé and bezel techniques

settings.question: Natural Black Diamond Signature
settings.answer:
Within the Warrior Soul collection, a single natural black diamond is embedded as a signature accent, and an innovation in ethics and modern design.


This stone is intentionally sourced from natural diamonds considered non-commercial with inclusions by large-scale waste mining. Through the HPHT process (High Pressure, High Temperature), which replicates the earth’s natural formation conditions, the diamond is transformed into its distinctive black form.


This element reflects a design philosophy rooted in slow, intentional adornment - challenging mass production and excess consumption, and instead embracing rarity, symbolism, and restraint.


SALLY SKOUFIS™ contributes 100% of the value of each Black Diamond accent back into environmental and community-focused initiatives impacted by extractive industry systems.

settings.question: Precious Metal
settings.answer:
All pieces are crafted using finest-grade solid 925 sterling silver as the foundational precious metal, finished with refined surface treatments to define each design language.

  • Base Metal: Finest-grade solid 925 Sterling Silver
  • Finishes: 18k Gold Vermeil, Premium Black Rhodium, or Silver Rhodium plating
  • Properties: Hypoallergenic, high-polish, tarnish-resistant


In addition to traditional precious metal craftsmanship, SALLY SKOUFIS™ is pioneering new material expressions through the ANAX Collection, introducing innovative forms of contemporary metalwork derived from recycled aluminium cans. This process transforms post-consumer materials into vibrant, sculptural surfaces rich in colour, texture, and modern contrast - expanding the boundaries of fine jewellery materiality.

settings.question: Craft and Construction
settings.answer:
Each SALLY SKOUFIS™ piece is created through the ancient lost-wax casting method, where initial sketches are translated into hand-sculpted wax forms before being cast in precious metal. This process enables sculptural depth, refined proportion, and exceptional precision, further elevated through meticulous hand finishing.


Key processes include:

  • Hand sketch development and sculptural wax modelling
  • Traditional lost-wax casting
  • Precision gemstone cutting for maximum brilliance and refraction
  • Micro-pavé setting under magnification
  • Hand finishing and polishing
  • Multi-stage quality inspection

SALLY SKOUFIS™ jewellery is designed as an expression of conscious luxury - where materiality, ethics, and craftsmanship converge to create pieces of enduring meaning, sculptural beauty, and refined integrity.

settings.question: Product Care: The Ritual of Preservation
settings.answer: Each SALLY SKOUFIS™ design is thoughtfully crafted with the intention of enduring a lifetime. With considered care, your pieces will retain their beauty, integrity, and refined finish for years to come.

settings.question: Precious Metal Care: Silver, Gold & Black Rhodium
settings.answer:
All precious metals used in SALLY SKOUFIS™ designs are responsibly sourced and selected to meet exacting standards, ensuring both longevity and timeless quality.

To preserve the natural lustre and refined finish of your gold, silver, and black rhodium jewellery, each piece should be treated with considered care.

Avoid contact with household cleaners, bleach, and harsh chemicals. Keep your jewellery dry, removing it before showering, swimming, or engaging in physical or manual activity. Store each piece separately to protect against scratching, tangling, and unnecessary wear.

settings.question: How to Clean Micro Pave Jewellery
settings.answer:
For optimal maintenance, immerse your piece in a gentle jewellery cleaning solution for up to two minutes. Carefully clean around pavé settings using a soft-bristled brush to remove any buildup. Rinse thoroughly, then pat dry with a soft, lint-free cloth. Finish with a light polish using a specialist gold or silver jewellery cloth.

With regular, delicate care, your piece will retain its clarity, brilliance, and signature SALLY SKOUFIS™ radiance.

settings.question: Leather Care
settings.answer:
Our exotic leathers are ethically sourced through conscious cooperatives. Each material is chosen for its beauty, quality, and longevity and should be treated with equal consideration.

Always test cleaning methods on a small, discreet area first.

Avoid saddle soap, oils, hairdryers, abrasive cleaners, furniture polish, varnish, or ammonia.

Stain Removal Guidelines

  • Oil-based stains: gently blot with a dry, clean white cloth. Do not use water.
  • General stains/spills: blot immediately. If needed, lightly clean with plain lukewarm water, then blot dry and air dry.
  • Mild cleaning solution: for persistent marks, use one part mild soap to ten parts water. Apply gently with a damp white cloth, rinse carefully, and air dry.

Each SALLY SKOUFIS™ piece is created with you at its center - reflecting a commitment to conscious design, individuality, and enduring quality. When you wear these pieces, you carry not only the design itself, but also the intention, energy, and craftsmanship behind its creation.

settings.title: PRODUCT CARE
settings.content: Every SALLY SKOUFIS™ design is crafted to last a lifetime. Learn how to care for your favorite pieces and maintain their beauty for years to come.

settings.title: SILVER, GOLD AND BLACK RHODIUM JEWELRY CARE
settings.content: We responsibly source all our precious metals. These materials must meet exacting standards in order to be used in SALLY SKOUFIS™ designs to preserve longevity.

settings.title: DAY-TO-DAY CARE
settings.content: To preserve the polish of your gold and silver jewelry, avoid exposure to household cleaning products and bleach. Keep them dry! Remove jewelry before showering, swimming or working with your hands.

settings.title: HOW TO CLEAN GOLD AND SILVER JEWELERY
settings.content:
1. Place your gold or silver jewelry into liquid jewelry cleaning solution.
  2. After two minutes, remove your jewelry from the solution.
  3. Gently clean behind the settings and in between crevices with a soft bristle brush to remove any debris.
  4. Rinse and blot dry entirely. Use an optional gold or silver jewelry cloth to further polish.

settings.title: LEATHER CARE
settings.content: Our exotic leathers are sourced from the finest conscious cooperatives globally. To preserve this precious material we suggest you follow our suggested guide.

settings.title: DAY-TO-DAY CARE
settings.content: Avoid excessive heat and exposure to moisture, which can affect the overall look of leather accessories. When not in use, store your item in its protective dust bag.

settings.title: HOW TO CLEAN LEATHER GOODS
settings.content: When cleaning leather, always test a small, hidden area first. Never use saddle soap, oils, hairdryers, abrasive cleaners, furniture polish, varnish or ammonia to clean

settings.title: SALLY SKOUFIS™ LEATHER ACCESSORIES.
settings.content:
To remove stains, oil-based spots and spills, follow the instructions below:

  1. To remove stains, use a mild solution of one part soap to 10 parts water.
  2. Apply gently with a wet white cloth and then fully rinse. Let air dry.
  3. To remove oil-based spots, use a dry white cloth to blot the area. The spot should quickly dissipate. Do not apply water to the spot.
  4. To remove other spots and spills, immediately blot the area with a clean, absorbent white cloth or sponge. If the stain persists, use plain lukewarm water to carefully clean the spot. Blot with a clean towel, then air dry.

My designs are made with you at the heart, respecting your desire for personal, conscious, quality and unique. With these pieces you are wearing the energy of my vision and the loving hands that made it – its about beauty and meaning.

settings.title: YOUR PRIVACY
settings.content:
Last updated: June 2023

At SALLYSKOUFIS.com we are committed to protecting your privacy as a customer and an online visitor to our website. We use the information we collect about you to maximize the services that we provide to you. We respect the privacy and confidentiality of the information provided by you and adhere to the Australian Privacy Principles. Please read our privacy policy below carefully.

INFORMATION WE COLLECT FROM YOU

In the course of your visits to our website or use of our products and services, we may obtain the following information about you: name, company name, email address, telephone number, credit card details, billing address, geographic location, IP address, survey responses, support queries, blog comments and social media handles (together ‘Personal Data’). You can review, correct, update or delete your Personal Data by either logging into your account and making the changes yourself or contacting us directly to do so.

HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

Personally Identifiable Information: We use the information we collect to deliver our services to you, including: communicating with you, providing technical support, notifying you of updates and order tracking, sharing useful content, measuring customer satisfaction, diagnosing problems and providing you with a personalized website experience. Marketing communications are only sent to you if you have requested or subscribed to them. You can opt out of our marketing communications at any time by unsubscribing or emailing us, and your request will be actioned immediately. Non-Personally Identifiable Information: We also use the information we collect in aggregated and anonymised forms to improve our services, including: administering our website, producing reports and analytics, advertising our products and services, identifying user demands and assisting in meeting customer needs generally. Any information you choose to make publicly available, such as blog comments and testimonials on our website, will be available for others to see. If you subsequently remove this information, copies may remain viewable in cached and archived pages on other websites or if others have copied or saved the information.

STORAGE AND SECURITY OF YOUR INFORMATION

We will use all reasonable means to protect the confidentiality of your Personal Data while in our possession or control. All information we receive from you is stored and protected on our secure servers from unauthorized use or access. Credit card information is encrypted before transmission and is not stored by us on our servers. To enable us to deliver our services, we may transfer information that we collect about you, including Personal Data, across borders for storage and processing in countries other than Australia. If your Personal Data is transferred and processed outside Australia, it will only be transferred to countries that have adequate privacy protections. We retain your personal information for as long as needed to provide services to you and as otherwise necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce our agreements. In the event there is a breach of our security and your Personal Data is compromised, we will promptly notify you in compliance with the applicable law.

COOKIES AND PIXELS

A cookie is a small file placed in your web browser that collects information about your web browsing behavior. Use of cookies allows a website to tailor its configuration to your needs and preferences. Cookies do not access information stored on your computer or any Personal Data (e.g. name, address, email address or telephone number). Most web browsers automatically accept cookies but you can choose to reject cookies by changing your browser settings. This may, however, prevent you from taking full advantage of our website. Our website uses cookies to analyze website traffic, provide social media sharing and liking functionality and help us provide a better website visitor experience. In addition, cookies and pixels may be used to serve relevant ads to website visitors through third party services such as Google Adwords and Facebook Adverts. These ads may appear on this website or other websites you visit.

SHARING YOUR INFORMATION WITH THIRD PARTIES

We do not and will not sell or deal in Personal Data or any customer information. Your Personal Data details are only disclosed to third party suppliers when it is required by law, for goods or services which you have purchased, for payment processing or to protect our copyright, trademarks and other legal rights. To the extent that we do share your Personal Data with a service provider, we would only do so if that party has agreed to comply with our privacy standards as described in this privacy policy and in accordance with applicable law. Our contracts with third parties prohibit them from using any of your Personal Data for any purpose other than that for which it was shared.

DISCLOSURE OF YOUR INFORMATION

We may from time to time need to disclose certain information, which may include your Personal Data, to comply with a legal requirement, such as a law, regulation, court order, subpoena, warrant, in the course of a legal proceeding or in response to a law enforcement agency request. Also, we may use your Personal Data to protect the rights, property or safety of sallyskoufis.com, our customers or third parties. If there is a change of control in one of our businesses (whether by merger, sale, transfer of assets or otherwise) customer information, which may include your Personal Data, could be transferred to a purchaser under a confidentiality agreement. We would only disclose your Personal Data in good faith and where required by any of the above circumstances.

LINKS TO OTHER WEBSITES

This website may contain links to other websites. These links are meant for your convenience only. Links to third party websites do not constitute sponsorship or endorsement or approval of these websites. Please be aware that we are not responsible for the privacy practices of such other websites. We encourage our users to be aware, when they leave our website, to read the privacy statements of each and every website that collects personally identifiable information. This privacy policy applies solely to information collected by this website.

CHANGE IN PRIVACY POLICY

As we plan to ensure our privacy policy remains current, this policy may be subject to change. We may modify this policy at any time, in our sole discretion and all modifications will be effective immediately upon our posting of the modifications on this website. Please return periodically to review our privacy policy.

CONTACT US

If you have any questions or concerns at any time about our privacy policy or the use of your Personal Data, please contact us at concierge@sallyskoufis.com and we will respond within 48 hours.

AMENDMENT OF TERMS

We reserve the right to change, modify, add or remove portions of these terms at any time. Please check these terms regularly prior to using our website to ensure you are aware of any changes. We will endeavor to highlight any significant or substantive changes to you where possible. If you choose to use our website then we will regard that use as conclusive evidence of your agreement and acceptance that these terms govern your and our rights and obligations to each other.
